visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Fields Overwrite Each Other
visualizerParams.problemDescription: After setting id to 7 and score to 2.5 the program should print id=7 score=2.5, but id is printed as 0.

solution.explanation: In a union both fields occupy the same bytes, so storing the double overwrites the bits that held the int. Use a struct when every field must keep its own value, and a union only when just one field is in use at a time.
